Enter a short code across coordinated single-character fields.

This page is lookup reference for the exact public contract. Start from the usage examples when you are composing or styling the component.

## Keyboard interaction

| Key | Behavior |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Arrow Left</kbd> / <kbd>Arrow Right</kbd> | Move between digit inputs. |
| <kbd>Backspace</kbd> / <kbd>Delete</kbd> | Clear a digit and preserve the expected cursor movement. |
| <kbd>Text input</kbd> | Accept valid characters and advance when the field is complete. |
